title: Female borrowers who mention owning their own home may fund faster.
Pitches from women that specify the loan amount, especially in local currency, are associated with slower funding speeds.
Female borrowers who provide details about specific social repayment programs may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention securing or providing for the family's future may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention specific family hardships fund faster.
Female borrowers who use formal or descriptive adjectives to characterize themselves may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who emphasize environmental sustainability and specific technology fund faster than those mentioning general supplies.
Female borrowers who specify exact types of supplies or inventory may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention specific environmental challenges like weather patterns may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention living in a refugee camp may fund faster.
Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention benefits to their family or community fund faster.
Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Mentioning a history of previous loan repayments predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Pitches that provide concrete financial figures or specific inventory lists fund faster regardless of gender.
Mentioning family obligations and benefits has opposite effects on funding speed by gender.
Providing specific demographic details, such as age or family member employment, predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who include explicit expressions of gratitude to lenders fund more slowly.
